end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Gave human examples, including muscle tissue, heart, and circulatory system.
Explained that cells form tissues and different tissues form organs.
The heart-versus-circulatory-system distinction remained a mix-up at the last mention.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised ordering the levels and linking each level to human examples. Yash used the building-and-bricks idea to explain why cells come before tissues and organs. They mixed up the heart (one organ) with the circulatory system; this was discussed but the distinction was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Yash to make a five-step diagram using one plant example and one human example.
